quote: “He drew a circle that shut me out — / Heretic, rebel, a thing to flout. / But Love and I had the wit to win: / We drew a circle that took him in!”
source: Edwin Markham, Outwitted, the whole poem, p. 1 (Voluntaries), The Shoes of Happiness, and Other Poems (Doubleday, Page, 1915)
